title: Continuity Checklist
description: Work through a safe continuity and low-resistance inspection with captured checkpoints.

steps.title: Verify Power Is Removed
steps.instruction: Confirm the circuit is de-energized before checking continuity.

steps.title: Capture Reference Path
steps.instruction: Capture the continuity or low-resistance reading for the known-good path.

steps.title: Capture Test Path
steps.instruction: Capture the continuity or low-resistance reading for the path under test.

steps.title: Record Continuity Result
steps.instruction: Note whether the test path matches expectations or needs more investigation.
